## Contract review

Reviewed at 2026-10-27T06:25Z — PR #26514 (card #25765, pm-dispatch: the full-review rule, Tier S), independent contract review at the ceiling tier, read-only, adversarial to the dispatch order, the claim and the dev's report. Inputs: the card body and its five comments (re-fetched over REST at 2026-10-27T06:14Z), the PR body, file list and diff over REST, the three files on `origin/main` (14f30991, whose tree for every file read here equals the branch point 00a4593a) and on the head via `git show`, `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, `references/execution-duties.md` and `.github/workflows/lint.yml` on `origin/main`, the check-runs and the lint jobs' step lists on the head.

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `54224ebf52a41689f74083074d636d48c5c85cc6`
Local-runs: probe — printed the record and brief templates of the head's own record-recognisers.mjs (--template and --brief-template, bare, --face narrowing and --paths over this PR's files, AGENTS.md and a skills/objectstack-ui list) from a git-archive copy of the head tree under the scratchpad, to read the shape item ④ introduces and the brief its first consumer receives; exit 0, printed text only — no self-test, no gate family, no build, nothing in the shared checkout
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md + scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (the third path of the diff: the printer and self-test the two rule files cite, read as one change with them), scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs (GOVERNED_SURFACES and governedPathsIn, the rules-face register), scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs (SUSPECT_TIER_GLOBS, the schema face), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (the two ceilings and the 120-byte line cap), scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs (why the card is not cited in the skill), .claude/agents/os-dev.md (body shape, HTML-comment exception, card-number ban), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md (where the retired per-face wording survives), .github/workflows/lint.yml (lane map)

**Check-runs on the head, read at 2026-10-27T06:20Z: 45 total — 28 success, 17 skipped, 0 failure, 0 in progress** (at 2026-10-27T06:14Z three were still running: Test Core 1/8, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · workspace; all three completed success). Lane map read in `lint.yml` on `origin/main` and confirmed on the jobs' step lists: `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (step 19, PM skill line ratchet), `check:pm-skill-id-lint` (step 20) and `check:pm-record-recognisers` (step 31, Contract-review record recogniser self-test, lint.yml line 1165) in **Lint · repo & tooling gates** — success; `check:role-word` (step 18, Reserved-word docs ratchet, line 2236) in **Lint · docs & code guards** — success; `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (step 5) in **Lint · PM dispatch-gates** — success; Governed Surface Queue Guard success; Check Changeset success with `skip-changeset`; the three claim/closing guards success. The 17 skipped are the UI, docs-build and opt-in lanes the path filter skips for a diff with no `ui/**` or `content/**`. Merge state: `blocked` at 2026-10-27T06:20Z while the last aggregate runs closed, `clean` at 2026-10-27T06:24Z; still a draft with no review and no PR comment, as Tier S intends until the seat readies it on this record and its own `## 席位核对`.

### ① Derived judgments

Nothing published changes: no `packages/**` file, no schema, no changeset. The public surfaces are the pm-dispatch rule text (governed, Tier S) and the two printers of `record-recognisers.mjs`. Each change, named right or wrong against the card's items 1–6 and the files on `origin/main`:

- **Faces (card item 3) — right, verified in the register, not taken from the body.** `reviewFace` reads `governedPathsIn(list, repo)` for the rules face and `deriveTier(list, [], SUSPECT_TIER_GLOBS)` for the schema face. `GOVERNED_SURFACES` on `origin/main` holds the `adr` row (`docs/adr/**`, Tier H), the whole-tree row for `.claude/**` (Tier S) and the `skills-catalog` row (`skills/**`, Tier H), so every surface the owner named already reads as the rules face or the schema face at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; no face is added and SKILL.md line 183's governed definition is untouched. Right. One precision the note does not state: the rules face is the WHOLE register — `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, `.github/workflows/**` and the six `ui/` mirrors also print ④ (measured: `--template --paths AGENTS.md` prints `### ④ Design judgment` at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`). That is wider than 「spec skills adr」, which the owner's 「或者至少」 makes a floor, so it is within the order; the ④ note's words 「the published spec, skills and ADR surfaces the full-review order names」 equate the face with the three surfaces and should read 「the governed register, which holds the three surfaces」 — should-fix, see ③.
- **`contract-review.md` lines 22–23 (record shape) — right.** 「①②③ 逐项(schema/governed 两面加 ④)」 matches `recordCarriesDesignJudgment(face, tier)`: true at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` for a null face (the bare template) or a face with `fullReview: true` (schema, rules); false on narrowing, declaration and below tier. Byte-identical to the body's fenced after-block.
- **Lines 30–32 (④ definition and scope, card items 1 and 5) — right.** 「逐 `hits` 文件判改动对所引代码与验收场景是否成立,ADR 另判首个消费者与执行计划;被引代码读而不审」 is the owner's refinement 6396446237 item 5 and the existing scope rule at line 14 (`reviewFace` hits + the files the hunks assert, cited code read); 「①–④ 合称完整复核,余面同形无 ④,⛔ 无第二条记录」 is the card's carrier choice (a fourth item, not a second record) and is the right choice against the locator: it reads the NEWEST `## Contract review` on the head, so a second record would shadow the first.
- **Line 33 (cadence, card item 6) — right**, the owner's words: one full review per substantive head, a delta review of a findings-only commit by the same reviewer, stop at the first round with no must-fix. The existing regeneration / prose-only head-move exception at lines 44–45 stays and is consistent (those are not substantive heads).
- **Line 41 (independence, card item 2) — right**: the drafter never reviews its own change, drafting at tier is no exemption, the feeding rule of line 36 applies. The `Implemented-by:`/`Reviewed-by:` pair (line 40) is the machine-read half; this line is the human-read half.
- **`SKILL.md` line 190 (card item 4) — right, and the retired words are not lost.** Old: 「技能面 hunk 复核随面定档:席未达档起隔离达档复核」; new: 「受管/spec 面欠完整复核 ①–④,席未达档起隔离达档复核」. The tier-follows-the-face rule survives verbatim in `contract-review.md` line 11 「档随面定」 and `references/execution-duties.md` line 113 「自审随面定档」; the pointer format before the semicolon is unchanged; 「受管面」 is already the file's own word (lines 26 and 164). Measured 118 bytes (was 111), under the 120-byte cap; 319 lines on both sides.
- **Line ceilings — right.** `contract-review.md` 49 → 55 of 60; `SKILL.md` 319 of 319; every non-fence line of `contract-review.md` ≤ 120 bytes (the seven new or changed lines measure 115, 29, 114, 112, 101, 116, 113 — the dev's 「longest new line 116」 is line 33, correct); `check:pm-skill-ratchet` green on the head is the verdict.
- **`record-recognisers.mjs` — right.** `fullReview` on the frozen face table (`true` schema and rules, `false` narrowing and declaration); `recordCarriesDesignJudgment` pure; `contractReviewRecordLines` takes an optional `faceId` and refuses an unknown one instead of printing the bare record; `contractReviewTemplateLines` passes the face through, so `--paths` over a mixed list resolves to the schema or rules face and prints ④; `contractReviewBriefLines` prints the ④ instruction and the surface-file scope rule on the same faces and neither on narrowing or declaration (measured on the head copy: `--brief-template --face narrowing` prints zero ④). No reader changed: the locator, the head-span, `Served-tier:`, `Reviewed-by:` and `Local-runs:` readers are untouched by the diff, and no other script imports the changed functions (grep over `scripts/**` and `.github/**` on the head finds no caller outside the file). The record I am writing is itself the live test that a four-section record reads FOUND on the readers `origin/main` runs.
- **Self-test — right, and the floors are measured.** Counting `t(` assertions per battery on both trees: the template battery 21 → 29 (+8), the brief battery 12 → 18 (+6), every other battery unchanged, 201 → 215 total — the dev's 14 pins, 8 + 6. The floors 19 → 27 and 10 → 16 rise by exactly the pins added and keep the two-case headroom each battery already had on `origin/main` (floors are 「at or above」, per the file's own comment); the roster stays 12. Every new printed line is pinned: the record heading (position right after ③, four `###` headings, the identity lines after it); all five lines of the template note (fragments from lines 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5); both lines of the brief's scope rule; all four lines of the brief's ④ item; the positive faces (schema, rules, `--paths` mixed) and the negative faces (narrowing fenced record, declaration with and without its face, below tier); the face table 「exactly schema,rules」 with every face answering a boolean; the unknown-`faceId` refusal; a ④ record still FOUND and STANDING on a real head; angle brackets, model identifiers and digit-shaped card numbers kept out of the brief.
- **PR body — right.** All eleven fenced blocks are byte-identical to the file on `origin/main` or the head, or to the printer on the head (checked by substring match, not by eye); the line-count table (49 → 55, 319 → 319, 2054 → 2134) matches `wc -l` on both trees; the six 速读 labels are in the fixed order with 需要你做的 = 无,席位落地 (right for Tier S); English sections in the os-dev order.

### ② Semver level

Right. `skip-changeset` with nothing published: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` belong to no npm package; Check Changeset success. `Clause-②: no` (line 4) and `Metadata-protocol: none` (line 5) are line-initial, after `Fixes #25765` on line 3 behind the two harness attribution lines — the shape the dispatch order itself specified and os-dev.md line 323's exception allows (`Fixes` immediately after the harness lines); the two closing-keyword guards on the head are green. No `Skills-docs:` line is owed (no `(narrowing)` arm, `Metadata-protocol: none`).

### ③ Boundary flags

The report (6435101147) carries `deviations` (8), `line_budget`, `open_questions: []`, `out_of_scope_findings` (one observation, carrier none); branch `claude/project-thread-osntoo` = the claim's branch; `mcp_calls: 0` (the two harness tools named are not GitHub MCP); `api_writes: 2` (relay `pr_create`, the report comment). Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no off-relay author to name. Each flag, answered:

1. Harness attribution lines 1–2 then `Fixes` on line 3 — nothing: os-dev.md line 323 and the dispatch order both prescribe it; the guards are green. Note only: the harness attribution comment's key word matches `MODEL_IDENTIFIER_FORM` by shape, but no gate scans the PR body with it and it names no model; the dev's 「no model identifier in this body」 holds in substance. The commit carries the model-free trailer pair.
2. GitHub MCP assignee step skipped; relay set `os-warren` and `skip-changeset`; no reviewer requested — nothing, right for Tier S.
3. The card not cited in the skill text — right, by rule: `check-skill-id-lint` pattern `/#[0-9]{3,}/` over `.claude/skills/**` and os-dev.md line 20 forbid it; the dispatch order's hypothesis 3 yields to os-dev.md, as the order itself says. Provenance in the script docblock is that file's convention (ruling-record ids are cited there already). Nothing.
4. Harness trailer not followed — right per os-dev.md 284; the commit's trailers are the harness session-URL trailer and a model-free co-author trailer. Nothing.
5. One amend before the first push, never force-pushed — one commit on the branch, `commits: 1`. Nothing.
6. Turn cut by an API error, resumed — nothing.
7. PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE headings folded — nothing, same reading as on PR #26385.
8. **④ not on the narrowing face — the dev's open question, answered: nothing is lost for the order as written, and widening is the owner's call, not this PR's.** Faces read the committed file list in order: schema first, then rules, then the declaration. A `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` on a PR whose diff touches `packages/spec/src/**` non-test or any governed path reads as the schema or rules face and carries ④ already. The narrowing face exists only when the diff holds none of those paths, so by construction it holds none of the three surfaces the owner named. What it can hold is a narrowing of a published accept set implemented in runtime code alone (say `packages/objectql`): the card's filer parenthetical 「"spec" = the published-schema face … and cards of the `domain:spec` lane」 would reach it by lane, but no face reads a lane label, and neither the triage line nor the dispatch order adopted that parenthetical. So: faithful to the order; a one-flag widening (`fullReview: true` on `narrowing`, line 30 reworded, two self-test pins flipped) if the owner wants it — a card candidate, below.
9. The dev's observation that the bare `--template` and `--brief-template` print ④ — agreed, no trap: `--paths` over a list carrying a changeset and no declaration is refused with the instruction to pass `--face narrowing` or `--face declaration`, and a list with no schema, governed or changeset path reads as the declaration face at `TIER_DEFAULT`, no ④.
10. Base reconciled: the PR's base sha 73683ee1 sits 13 commits past the branch point 00a4593a and `origin/main` (14f30991) two further; none of those 15 commits touches the three files, the register, the suspect globs, the queue guard, the ratchet or `lint.yml` (`git log` over those paths is empty), so the judgments above hold against `origin/main` as it stands.
11. Should-fix, not must-fix (next head or a follow-up card): (a) the ④ note's wording, per ① — the rules face is the governed register, wider than the three surfaces; (b) the brief's ④ names the accepted scenario for an ADR only (first consumer and execution plan); for a skill file the scenario is the card's eval prompt and the spec it teaches on `origin/main`, and for a schema file the ruling or ADR it implements and its first consumer — the printed brief leaves a seat to supply that by hand (measured: `--brief-template --paths skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md …` prints the generic ④ item with the three paths as hits, sensible but scenario-less).

### ④ Design judgment

Judged per `hits` file against the code it cites and the scenario it is accepted against; the cited code read, not reviewed.

- **`contract-review.md`** — holds. Its first consumer is this lane's next brief (the seat will generate it from the new `--brief-template`), and its first scenario is this PR: a Tier S pm-dispatch head with a rules-face hit. Filled truthfully here: the design (④ as a fourth section of the one record) holds against the locator (newest `## Contract review` on the head; a `###` line is never the marker, pinned in the locator battery of the self-test, so ④ is prose to the readers), against the independence pair (unchanged keys), and against the queue guard (presence of `Reviewed-by:` and a standing `Served-tier:` — neither reads section headings). Tried to break it: a seat that copies an old ①②③ record onto a rules-face PR is refused by nothing — no gate reads ④'s presence, exactly as triage ordered (⛔ no new gate), so the enforcement is the seat's `## 席位核对` reading the record against lines 22–23; the rule says so (「同形 = …」) and the seat's checklist line 191 (核对六项: 形态) is where it is checked. A second record is forbidden by line 32 and the locator would shadow it anyway. The cadence line reads cleanly beside the line 44 exception. No must-fix.
- **`SKILL.md` line 190** — holds. The pointer format is unchanged and the clause names what the two path-read faces owe (①–④) and who runs it below tier; `①–④` resolves in `contract-review.md`; nothing else in `.claude/**` still states the record as ①②③ alone (grep on the head finds only line 22, now amended). No must-fix.
- **`record-recognisers.mjs`** (read as the gate of the rule) — holds against its callers: `contractReviewRecordLines` keeps its signature (`faceId` optional), `--template` without arguments prints the at-tier default with ④, which is the right default for the tier the bare template already declares; the narrowing-face omission is a flag read off the one table, never a second list. Should-fix only, named in ③ (11a, 11b).

## 维护者速读
改了什么:pm-dispatch 技能的契约复核规则加第 ④ 项「设计判断」:碰已发布 schema 面或受管规则面(含 spec、skills、ADR,按受管登记表)的 PR,达档复核除 ①②③ 外还逐个命中文件判「改动对所引代码与验收场景是否成立」(ADR 另判首个消费者与执行计划);范围只限面上文件,被引代码读而不审;一次实质 head 一轮完整复核,只改复核意见的提交由同一复核者做增量复核,无 must-fix 即止;复核者不得是起草者。记录模板与简报模板(`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`)印出 ④,自检加 14 条钉住;`contract-review.md` 49 → 55 行(上限 60),`SKILL.md` L190 同行改写(319/319)。
为什么改:田騏 10-25 的原话「spec skills adr 都需要fable 完整的复核」「fable 复核应该只针对pr中的重要文件」;PR #25717 两轮合同复审都 PASS 后,独立完整复核才找出三处必须改的设计缺陷。
风险与回滚:只改技能文本与模板打印/自检,无门禁新增(分诊 ⛔ no new gate);回滚 = revert 本 PR(一个提交)。风险在 ④ 只靠席位核对 contract-review.md L22–23 的形态检查执行,没有门禁读它——一张旧式 ①②③ 记录贴到规则面 PR 上不会被机器拒绝。
先看:① `references/contract-review.md` L22–23、L30–33、L41;② `SKILL.md` L190;③ `record-recognisers.mjs` 的 `fullReview` 标志与 `--template` / `--brief-template` 的 ④ 段。
两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers`(215 例)与 `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 全绿;`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --template --paths docs/adr/0001-x.md` 印出 `### ④ Design judgment`。
需要你做的:无。Tier S,契约复核 PASS + 本核对后席位 ready 并布自动合并。
席位意见:同意落地。两条 should-fix 不压本 PR,进后续卡:④ 注解把规则面写成「spec/skills/ADR 三面」,实际是整张受管登记表(含 AGENTS.md、workflows);简报 ④ 只写了 ADR 的验收场景,skill 文件应对卡上 eval 题与所教 spec、schema 文件应对其实现的裁决/ADR 与首个消费者。另一条归你裁:④ 要不要也盖「收窄申报」面(只在运行时代码收窄已发布接受集、不碰三面路径时才会出现),一个标志翻转。

2. **Record, measured.** The reviewer read the faces in the register, not the body: `GOVERNED_SURFACES` on `origin/main` holds `docs/adr/**` (H), `.claude/**` (S), `skills/**` (H) and `reviewFace` reads `governedPathsIn` + `deriveTier(…, SUSPECT_TIER_GLOBS)`, so the owner's three surfaces were already faces, no face added, SKILL.md L183 untouched; the rules face is the whole register (④ also prints for AGENTS.md — within 「或者至少」).
